topic: How do distributed satellite constellations impact orbital configuration trade-offs between coverage and inter-satellite interference mitigation?
consensus_response: Distributed constellations offer improved coverage through wider beam distribution, but increased ISI requires advanced algorithms like SAB and NCS for optimal signal steering and spacing.  Frequency bands play a crucial role, impacting both coverage and signal propagation characteristics. Dense constellations necessitate careful consideration of latency and system complexity to balance operational costs with performance requirements.
